title: Sauti Sokoni
author: Somo team (XPRIZE Kenya)
description: The market seller calls a sound. Put the things with that sound in the kiondo basket. Level 1: first sound; level 2: last sound; level 3: middle sound.
description_sw: Muuzaji anaita sauti. Weka vitu vyenye sauti hiyo kwenye kiondo. Kiwango 1: sauti ya kwanza; 2: ya mwisho; 3: ya kati.

lines.en: Tap the green button to start.
Welcome to the market! I call a sound. Put things that START with that sound in the basket.
lines.sw: Karibu sokoni! Ninaita sauti. Weka vitu vinavyoANZA na sauti hiyo kwenye kiondo.

lines.en: Now listen for the LAST sound, at the end of the word.
lines.sw: Sasa sikiliza sauti ya MWISHO, mwishoni mwa neno.

lines.en: Now listen for the MIDDLE sound, inside the word.
lines.sw: Sasa sikiliza sauti ya KATI, ndani ya neno.

lines.en: Who has things that start with {s}? Put them in the basket.
lines.sw: Nani ana vitu vinavyoanza na {s}? Viweke kwenye kiondo.

lines.en: Find things that end with {s}. Put them in the basket.
lines.sw: Tafuta vitu vinavyoishia na {s}. Viweke kwenye kiondo.

lines.en: Which one has {s} in the middle? Put it in the basket.
lines.sw: Kipi kina {s} katikati? Kiweke kwenye kiondo.

lines.en: Tap a thing to hear its name.
Say it slowly: {w}. Listen to the first sound. Is it {s}?
lines.sw: Sema polepole: {w}. Sikiliza sauti ya kwanza. Ni {s}?

lines.en: Say it slowly: {w}. Listen to the very end. Is it {s}?
lines.sw: Sema polepole: {w}. Sikiliza mwisho kabisa. Ni {s}?

lines.en: Say it slowly: {w}. Listen to the middle. Is it {s}?
These are the ones. Watch them go in the basket.
lines.sw: Hivi ndivyo. Tazama vikiingia kwenye kiondo.
